Small houses stood side by side along a road that had not received much attention in the matter of paving.

en.html:
...A very comfortable silence, if comfort meant not being able to open one's mouth. We had not exchanged a single word yet.

Muramasa must have things she was keeping to herself. Naturally. On my side, every recollection of last night's disgrace made speaking more difficult. Naturally, again.

What was I to do?
I knew there was no way around it. Apologise without excuses. But...

Muramasa"Listen."
Kageaki"...?"
Muramasa"Are you feeling... a little better?"
Kageaki"..."
Kageaki"Yes. Perhaps..."
Muramasa"I see..."
Kageaki"..."
Muramasa"..."
Kageaki"Muramasa."
Muramasa"What?"
Kageaki"...About yesterday."
Muramasa"—"
Muramasa"Y-yes."
Kageaki"...Ah. That is..."
Kageaki"I am sorry."
Muramasa"..."
Kageaki"Not that saying sorry makes it all right..."
Muramasa"...It is all right. Don't worry about it."
Kageaki"I cannot simply leave it at that."
Muramasa"...I..."
Muramasa"W-what I mean is, if you wanted my help—"
Kageaki"In any case, I give you my word. That foolish behaviour ends there."
Muramasa"...Eh?"
Kageaki"I will never make you carry everything like that again."
